scenes.caption: A book.
scenes.say: Hamza reads a story about a village near a volcano.

scenes.caption: A calm start.
scenes.say: On page one the village is calm. Children play.

scenes.caption: A hint.
scenes.say: On page three, a cup rattles. A small hint.

scenes.caption: Worry grows.
scenes.say: On page five the dogs bark. The fear is growing.

scenes.caption: A turning point.
scenes.say: Then the mountain rumbles. A turning point.

scenes.caption: A graph.
scenes.say: Hamza draws an emotions graph. The line falls as fear rises.

scenes.caption: Relief.
scenes.say: At the end the family is safe. The line rises again.

scenes.caption: A tense tale.
scenes.say: Hamza sees how hints, pace and turning points build tension.
